name: Arlysia, City Entrance
desc1: The northern entrance to Arlysia is simply a large stone path leading
desc2: up steps carved into the mountains and to the massive doors of the
desc3: great library. The library has long been Arlysia's pride and joy.
desc4: From here, it is difficult to judge how large the actual library might
desc5: be, since it is built into the actual mountainside.
